findings.title: website_name include hook misnamed so it never runs
findings.body: In app/serializers/user_serializer.rb the method is defined as `include_website_name` without a trailing `?`, while ActiveModel::Serializers looks for `include_website_name?` (as used by every other hook in the file like `include_email?` and `include_stats?`). As a result the `website.present?` guard is never called and `website_name` is always serialized, even when `website` is blank (as nil). Fix by renaming to `include_website_name?`.

findings.title: website_name leaks TL0 user website to anonymous users
findings.body: `website` is listed in `untrusted_attributes` so it is hidden from anonymous viewers for TL0 users via `scope.restrict_user_fields?`, but the newly added `website_name` (host plus path) is only added to `attributes` and not to `untrusted_attributes`. An anonymous client can therefore learn a TL0 user's website domain/path from `website_name` even when `website` itself is suppressed. Fix by adding `website_name` to the untrusted list / making its include check respect `restrict_user_fields?`.

findings.title: Host comparison is case-sensitive and nil-unsafe
findings.body: In app/serializers/user_serializer.rb `website_name` compares `URI(website).host` directly to `Discourse.current_hostname` with `==` and calls `split`/`ends_with?` on `discourse_host` without guarding nil or case. Hostnames are case-insensitive, so `http://EXAMPLE.COM/foo` on host `example.com` fails the equality and returns only the host without the path. If `Discourse.current_hostname` is ever nil, `split` raises NoMethodError and breaks all user serialization with a 500. Fix by downcasing both hosts and guarding nil.

findings.title: TL0 untrusted test omits website_name
findings.body: The spec's `untrusted_attributes` list in spec/serializers/user_serializer_spec.rb does not include `website_name`, so the test that TL0 attributes are hidden from anonymous never checks the new field. This allows the privacy leak above to pass CI. Fix by adding `website_name` to that list.
